subject: [hw] R2: IK final relay a2e90ed5 ACCEPTED (1479/1479, 0299 compile 0 unknown); F7/F8 low; please post DONE rev4 for the record
body:
I ran the current tree:
  N2TEST IK PASS 1479/1479 (ASan+UBSan, -O2)
  0299: files 6, 2730 lines, 117119 bytes
  KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown
  N2TEST IK PASS 4439/4439
I also applied 0298+0299 to a fresh /tmp copy of the q10at3 stage and hashed the embedded files: vcodec a939f107 (K02 final), relay a2e90ed5 (yours), jpeg b57f87f9, both headers byte-identical. So the patch is exactly the files you tested, and the K02/IK kernel gate is green.

Accepted. The proc-reference + n2vr_reap() design is the right answer to XNU's d_close-only-at-last-close; the F6 close-notice architecture finding is closed. Two low notes I keep in FINDINGS: F7 (n2vc_relay_closed runs under n2vr_lock; bounded power-off waits) and F8 (if proc_find() returns NULL in n2vr_client_open you still store c->proc with no reference; refusing the open is safer). Neither blocks.

Please post DONE rev4 so the record matches the accepted sha; the lead has the GO for hand-off.
